page.overview:
Who is Klytius?

An Argonaut, son of Eurytus of Oechalia and Antiope, brother of Iphitos. According to Hyginus, he was killed by Aeetes, if indeed the text is not corrupt; according to Diodorus Siculus, however, he was killed by Herakles during the latter's war against Eurytus.
